spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (शोभति-ते) r. 6th cl. (शुभति)
1 To be splendid, to shine.
2 To be beautiful or handsome.
r. 1st and 6th cls. (शोभति शुभति)
To hurt or injure, to kill.
r. 1st cl. (शोभति)
To speak.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
1 Happy, well, right, fortunate, auspicious.
2 Handsome, beautiful.
3 Splendid, shining.
4 Eminent, distinguished.
5 Learned, versed in the Vedas, &c.
n. (-भं)
1 Good, good fortune, auspiciousness, happiness.
m. (-भः)
One of the astrological Yogas.
f. (-भा)
1 An assemblage of the gods.
2 A female friend and companion of the goddess

UMĀ.
3

Bambu manna.
4 Bent grass.
5 The Śami tree.
6 A yellow pigment: see गोरोचना.
7 Light, lustre.
8 Beauty.
E.
शुभ to shine, aff. क.

r. 1st cl. (सोभति) r. 6th cl. (सुभति)
1 To speak.
2 To shine.
3 To hurt or kill.

mfn. (-युः-युः-यु)
Happy, fortunate, prosperous.
E.
शुभं happy, युस् poss. aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Propitious, producing good, &c.
E.
शुभ, and कर what makes: also शुभङ्कर.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Pious or virtuous act.
2 Reputable occupation or employment.
E.
शुभ, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
1 Elegant, graceful.
2 Fortunate, propitious.
E.
शुभ, and गम to go or obtain, ड aff.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
1 Pleasing to the eye, grateful to the sight.
2 Beloved, liked.
3 Fortunate, auspicious.
m. (-गः)
1

Borax.
2

The Asoca tree.
3 The Champac, (Michelia champaca.)
f. (-गा)
1 A woman beloved by her husband, a favourite wife.
2 A respectable and auspicious mother.
3 A wild variety of Arabian jasmine.
4

Turmeric.
5

Holy basil.
6 A shrub, (Hedysarum Gangeticum.)
E.
सु good, excellent, and भग fortune, beauty, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Propitious, auspicious, conferring happiness or fortune.
f. (-री)
PĀRVATĪ.
E.
शुभ happiness, कृ to make, खच् aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Propitious, auspicious.
E.
शुभ, and द who or what gives.

f. (-न्ती)
1 The female elephant of the N. W. quarter.
2 A woman with good teeth.
E.
शुभ handsome, दन्त tooth, ङीप् aff.; elsewhere read शुभ्रदन्ती.

n. (-लं)
Happy result or consequence.
E.
शुभ, and फल fruit.

m. (-ग्नः)
An auspicious moment.
E.
शुभ, and लग्न rise of a planet.

m. (-नः)
Perfume for the mouth.
E.
शुभ auspicious, वासन perfuming.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Of a good disposition.
E.
शुभ, and शील disposition.

f. (-ली)
A room or hall in which sacrifices are offered.
E.
शुभ auspicious, and स्थल place.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Handsome, elegant.
f. (-ङ्गी)
1 The wife of

KĀMA.
2
The wife of

KUVERA.
3

A handsome woman.
E.
शुभ handsome, and अङ्ग body.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Separating or dividing easily.
m. (-ङ्गः)
The cocoanut tree.
E.
सु, and भङ्ग breaking.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Virtuous.
f. (-रा)
A female attendant on UMĀ.
E.
शुभ, and आचार observance.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga): see शोभाञ्जन.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
E.
a various reading of शुभाञ्जन.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Handsome, good-looking.
f. (-ना)
A handsome woman.
E.
शुभ, and आनन face.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Happy, prosperous, fortunate.
E.
शुभ good fortune, and अन्वित endowed with.

f. (-ङ्गा)
A beautiful woman.
E.
शुभ, and अपाङ्ग the corner of the eye, for the eye or face.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Prosperous and unfortunate, good and evil.
n. (-भं)
Good and ill fortune.
E.
शुभ, and अशुभ unlucky.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Unlucky, inauspicious.
2 Evil, bad.
E.
शुभ, and इतर other.

mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्रा-भ्रं)
1

White.
2

Shining.
m. (-भ्रः)
1 White, (the colour.)
2 Sandal.
n. (-भ्रं)
1

Talc.
2

Silver.
3

Green vitriol.
f. (-भ्रा)
1 The

Ganges.
2

Crystal.
3

Bambu manna.
E.
शुभ to shine, रक् aff.

m. (-कृत्)
The thirty-sixth year of the Indian cycle.
E.
शुभ्र white, and कृत् making.

f. (-न्ती)
The female elephant of the north-west quarter.
E.
शुभ्र white, दन्त a tusk, ङीप् aff.

m. (-श्मिः)
The sun.
E.
शुभ्र white, and रश्मि a ray.

m. (-शुः)
1 The moon.
2 Camphor.
E.
शुभ्र white, and अंशु a ray.

m. (-भ्रिः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
शुभ to be propitious, क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Become pleasant or agreeable.
E.
सुभग, भू to be, खुकञ् aff.

m. (-तः)
The son of an auspicious mother.
E.
सुभगा as above, and सुत son.

m. (-टः)
A champion, a warrior.
E.
सु, and भट a warrior.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
Propitious, auspicious, fortunate.
m. (-द्रः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
f. (-द्रा)
1 The sister of JAGANNĀTHA, whose image is worshipped with those of that deity, and his brother BALARĀMA, and carried in procession with them in the Raṭh Yātra, or annual movement of the car of JAGANNĀTHA; she is the wife of

ARJUNA.
2

A creeper, (Echites frutescens.)
3 A plant, commonly Ghṛtamaṇḍā.
E.
सु exceedingly, भद्र auspicious.

n. (-कं)
A car of the gods.
m. (-कः)
A tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-णी)
A plant and drug, commonly Trāyamāṇa.

m. (-शः)
A name of ARJUNA.
E.
सुभद्रा the sister of JAGANNĀTHA, and ईश lord.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Heavily burthened.
E.
सु, and भर bearing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Spoken well or eloquently.
2 Wellspoken, speaking or discoursing well.
n. (-तं)
Eloquence.
m. (-तः)
A deified sage, according to the Bauddhas.
E.
सु good, excellent, भाषा speech, इतच् aff., or भाष to speak, aff. क्त.

f. (-क्षा)
A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.)
E.
सु well, भिक्ष to beg, or obtain by begging, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.)

m. (-मः)
A name of KĀRTAVĪRYA, as the eighth Cakravartī, or universal emperor, according to the Jainas.
E.
सु good, भूमि land, domain.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cherished, protected.
E.
सु well, भृत nourished.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Much, exceeding.
n. adv. (-शं)
Much, excessive.
E.
सु insensitive prefix, and भृश much.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Desirable, fit to be enjoyed.
E.
सु, भोग enjoyment, ख aff.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Very fearful, terrific.
E.
सु, and भैरव the same.

f. (-भ्रुः or भ्रूः)
A woman.
E.
सु handsome, and भ्रु or भ्रू an eyebrow.
